name: Cradle
tagline: AI protein-engineering platform for faster lab design rounds.
description: Cradle is an AI-powered protein-engineering SaaS platform that guides scientists through design rounds — candidate generation, multi-property optimization, and results analysis — using ML models trained per-customer on proprietary wet-lab data. It runs its own validation wet lab in Amsterdam and serves biopharma and industrial-biotech R&D teams including Novo Nordisk and Johnson & Johnson. It is sold via subscription with no royalties, and customers keep full IP.
insight: Amsterdam-based; raised a $73M Series B led by IVP in Nov 2024, taking total funding past $100M, and runs its own validation wet lab.
edge: Self-serve web SaaS for protein engineering with per-customer models and an in-house wet lab — a usable product where most rivals are partnership-only.

references.title: AI protein discovery platform Cradle raises $73M
